title: MetricFlow Failures by Metric
app: dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow query logs via the JDBC/GraphQL API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=semantic_layer:query status="error"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by metric_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts MetricFlow failures grouped by metric so operators immediately see which specific metrics are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'MetricFlow is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest MetricFlow failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical metrics.
visualization: Table of metric by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of MetricFlow are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
